svg.title: ReverseAI infrastructure
svg.desc: On the trusted host, an AI agent over MCP stdio or the command line drives the ReverseAI engine: intake freezes the approved file, a gateway allows fixed operations within budgets, built-in parsers read the formats, tool replies are re-derived from the bytes, evidence is recorded and an independent reviewer labels each claim; reports are written privately. Heavy tools (Ghidra, JADX, LIEF, YARA-X, the Babel parser) run in a Docker Desktop Linux VM, one fresh locked container per request, receiving only a read-only snapshot and a fixed request, and returning a bounded reply that the host treats as untrusted.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One machine you trust. Every heavy tool in its own locked container. Nothing from the file runs.
